# How to create an import code for your project

Source: [1724](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/1724); edited 2022-12-02. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-1724-n1"></a>

- Share/import code snapshots the entire lobby settings state, excluding players/bots/AI; prepare intended settings and remove unwanted debug/datacenter tweaks before sharing.

<a id="wiki-1724-n2"></a>

- Create New Code makes a new snapshot code; Upload to Existing Code overwrites a previously created code's content.

Source limitations:

- UI steps and PC-only clipboard note dated2022-12-02; no current share-code retention or permissions policy is established.
